note: npc-purpose rate gate (dev/test/npc-purpose-rates.js). track = the review's rate table (review-npc-purpose.md §6) + the visitor card spread; ratio = (head+1)/(base+1) must stay in band (row band or the default); rows with base+head < minN are not judged. rare = registered kinds allowed to fire 0 times in the bot run, each with the reason. base = counts of the build without npc-purpose (written by --base <f> --write-base).

rare.bulTell: jtsb bullying victim tells: needs 2+ bullyings with evidence; rare in 200 tuần
